thread.title: Verizon throws in Apple Music to its top unlimited plans - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jason Aycock
title: Verizon throws in Apple Music to its top unlimited plans - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Verizon (NYSE: VZ ) is expanding a partnership with Apple Music (NASDAQ: AAPL ), offering the streaming service as a built-in inclusion in its Beyond Unlimited and Above Unlimited plans.
Since last summer the carrier has been promoting an inclusion of six months of Apple Music for subscribers.
That six-months-free offer will still be good for those choosing Go Unlimited plans. The price goes to $9.99/month for those subscribers after that.
